title: 13. Dependencies & Tech Stack
description: Complete breakdown of runtime dependencies, npm packages, and Python requirements used across the project.
content:
Node.js Dependencies (package.json)

Runtime Dependencies

PackageVersionPurpose
<code>@sap/cds</code><code>^10.0.5</code>SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (OData V4, CQL, service gateway)
<code>@sap-cloud-sdk/connectivity</code><code>^4.8.0</code>Zero-hardcoding BTP Destination Auto-Selection Engine
<code>@sap-cloud-sdk/http-client</code><code>^4.8.0</code>Authenticated outbound HTTP via BTP Destinations
<code>@sap-cloud-sdk/resilience</code><code>^4.8.0</code>Resilient HTTP (timeouts, retries) for destination calls
<code>@cap-js/hana</code><code>^3.0.2</code>SAP HANA Cloud DB adapter for CDS

Dev Dependencies

PackageVersionPurpose
<code>@cap-js/sqlite</code><code>^3.0.2</code>In-memory SQLite for local dev/testing (no HANA needed)
<code>@sap/cds-dk</code><code>^10.0.7</code><code>cds</code> CLI — build, deploy, watch
<code>@sap/hdi-deploy</code><code>^5.7.0</code>SAP HANA HDI container deployer

Python Dependencies (python/requirements.txt)

Core Database, Redis & Networking

PackageVersionPurpose
<code>hdbcli</code><code>>=2.20.0</code>SAP HANA Cloud Python client for <code>REAL_VECTOR(1536)</code> embeddings & <code>COSINE_SIMILARITY()</code> search
<code>redis</code><code>>=5.0.0</code>SAP BTP <code>redis-instance</code> client for prompt/response caching (< 5ms TTL lookups)
<code>httpx</code><code>>=0.27.0</code>Async HTTP streaming client (SSE token streaming to <code>/ai/ask/stream</code>)
